about: Demography rules read by engine.py on every step; edit them and the next turn uses the new values. A copy goes into each turn's manifest. Rates are per year (one turn).

births.about: Placeholder until a decision model (birth_rates() in engine.py) chooses when to have children. per_person_per_year_by_age lists [age, births per person per year] points, filled in linearly between them, counting men and women alike: each birth counts half to the mother and half to the father, at their own ages, so the rates cover both (half the people are women) and add up over a lifetime to half the children per woman. Derived from a forager-like fertility of about 5.8 children per woman, with fathers older on average and fathering children over a longer span. Gives about 38 births per 1,000 people a year at the turn-0 age structure.
